item.title: San Francisco’s Teachers Strike Has Ended. What Comes Next?
item.description: San Francisco teachers and the district reached a tentative agreement that boosts wages and fully funds health care. Schools are set to reopen on Wednesday.

item.title: San Francisco Teachers Win Fully Funded Health Care, Wage Increases After 4-Day Strike
item.description: San Francisco’s first teachers strike in nearly 50 years concluded early Friday with a tentative agreement addressing the union’s concerns over health care, salaries and other key issues.

item.title: Stanford Pro-Palestinian Protesters Case Ends in Mistrial
item.description: Santa Clara County District Attorney Jeff Rosen said he plans to retry the case.

item.title: File Your Taxes With an ITIN? What We Know Right Now About the IRS-ICE Data Agreement
item.description: A federal judge has temporarily blocked the agreement that previously allowed the IRS to share with ICE the personal information of noncitizen taxpayers. This is what experts told us taxpayers should know ahead of filing.

item.title: Factory-Built Housing Hasn’t Taken Off in California Yet, but This Year Might Be Different
item.description: Building homes inside a factory has long been seen as a way to revolutionize the American housing industry, ushering in a new era of higher quality homes at lower price. That dream has never quite panned out. Can California finally make it happen?

item.title: Why Silicon Valley Got Cozy With the Military
item.description: Big Tech has now embraced working closely with the federal government, in large part due to lucrative contracts for military and surveillance technology.

item.title: From Armenia to San Francisco: The Duduk Whisperer Plays with Soul
item.description: The Bay Area Armenian musician reviving centuries old traditions through his duduk compositions.

item.title: How to Do a Cozy Winter Cabin Getaway Near the Bay Area — on a Budget
item.description: If you’re down for adventure — and to bring your own bedding — these primitive cabins offer a wallet-friendly winter getaway.

item.title: What Happens When Democrats in San Francisco Call Up Republicans in Texas? It’s Pretty Cordial
item.description: Over the past month, a social experiment seeking to bridge political divides has connected callers in San Francisco and Abilene, Texas.

item.title: Trump Administration Sends Pregnant Unaccompanied Minors to Texas Shelter Flagged as Medically Inadequate
item.description: There's concern the administration is concentrating pregnant unaccompanied minors in Texas to restrict abortion access.
